subject: Chemistry
title: Mendeleev's Card Game
description: A 60-second lesson on Mendeleev's Card Game.

hook.text: Dmitri Mendeleev wrote each known element on a card and played a game of chemical solitaire.

buildup.text: By 1869, 63 elements were known. Several chemists tried to organize them, but nothing worked.

discovery.text: Mendeleev arranged cards by atomic weight and noticed properties repeated in regular intervals.

twist.text: Legend says the final arrangement came to him in a dream. He wrote it down the moment he woke.

climax.text: He published the periodic table in 1869. It organized all of chemistry in a single chart.

punchline.text: A card game solved chemistry. The table that explains matter.

quiz.question: How did Mendeleev organize the elements in his periodic table?
options: By atomic weight, noticing repeating properties
By the year they were discovered

details.summary: In 1869, Dmitri Mendeleev arranged 63 known elements on cards sorted by atomic weight and discovered that elements with similar chemical properties appeared at regular intervals..
details.whyItMatters: Mendeleev's periodic table is considered one of the greatest intellectual achievements in science. Its predictive power transformed chemistry from a collection of facts into a systematic science capable of forecasting discoveries.
takeaways: Mendeleev wrote element properties on cards and arranged them by atomic weight
He noticed similar properties recurring at regular periodic intervals
His table predicted undiscovered elements whose later discovery proved him right

faq.question: Did Mendeleev really use physical cards to build the periodic table?
faq.answer: Yes. Mendeleev wrote each element's name, atomic weight, and key properties on individual cards. He arranged and rearranged them like a game of solitaire until patterns emerged. He reportedly fell asleep exhausted and saw the completed arrangement in a dream, though the story may be embellished.

faq.question: Why was Mendeleev's table more successful than similar attempts by other scientists?
faq.answer: Others like Newlands noticed periodicity but lacked Mendeleev's boldness. Mendeleev left deliberate gaps for undiscovered elements and even corrected accepted atomic weights when they disrupted his pattern..
